author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: তুলনা/বৈসাদৃশ্য দেখিয়ে একটি paragraph লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 15 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Past and Present' ways of life.
items.model: The past and the present differ in many ways, yet both have their own charm. In the past, people led a simple and quiet life. They had few needs and depended mostly on nature. In the present, on the other hand, life has become fast, busy and full of comforts. The biggest difference lies in science and technology. In the past there were no computers, mobile phones or fast vehicles, while today these have made our life easy and comfortable. In terms of communication, people of the past had to wait days for a letter, whereas now we can talk to anyone within a moment. However, the past had some good sides too. People were more honest, healthy and free from tension, while modern people suffer from pollution and stress. In spite of these differences, both ages aim at human welfare. So, we should take the good sides of both the past and the present.
rubric: তুলনার শব্দ (while, whereas, on the other hand) ব্যবহার করেছি
grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Radio and Television'.
items.model: Radio and television are two popular means of entertainment and information, but they differ in many ways. The most obvious difference is that a radio gives only sound, while a television gives both sound and picture. For this reason, television is more attractive and lively than radio. In terms of price, a radio is cheap and can be bought by the poor, whereas a television is costly. Moreover, a radio is small and light, so it can be carried easily from place to place, while a television is heavy and usually kept in a fixed place. On the other hand, a radio does not need electricity all the time and can run on batteries, but a television mostly depends on electricity. In spite of these differences, both radio and television serve the same purpose. They both give us news, education and entertainment. So, both have their own importance in our daily life.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Rural Life and Urban Life'.
items.model: Rural life and urban life are two different ways of living, and each has its own advantages and disadvantages. Rural life is calm, quiet and close to nature, while urban life is busy, noisy and crowded. The people of villages breathe fresh air and enjoy natural beauty, whereas town people live in a polluted and mechanical environment. In terms of facilities, urban life is far ahead. Towns have good schools, colleges, hospitals and markets, while villages often lack these modern facilities. There is also a difference in human relations. Village people are simple, friendly and helpful, whereas town people are mostly busy and hardly know their neighbours. However, both rural and urban life have some similarities too. People in both places work hard to earn their living and dream of a better future. In short, rural life gives peace and urban life gives comfort, so an ideal life needs a balance of the two.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Childhood and Old Age'.
items.model: Childhood and old age are two important stages of human life, and they are quite different from each other. Childhood is the beginning of life, while old age is its closing part. A child is full of energy, joy and hope, whereas an old man is weak, tired and often full of worries. In childhood a person has no burden of responsibility and passes his days in play and study. In old age, on the other hand, a person becomes free from work but often feels lonely and helpless. There is a difference in health too. A child is usually healthy and active, while an old man suffers from various diseases. However, both stages have some similarities. In both childhood and old age a person depends on others for care and love. Both a child and an old man need the affection of the family. So, we should love our children and respect and serve our elders.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Letter and Email'.
items.model: A letter and an email are two means of written communication, but they differ in many ways. The main difference is about speed. A letter takes several days to reach the receiver, while an email reaches within a few seconds. In terms of cost, a letter needs paper, an envelope and a stamp, whereas an email can be sent almost free of cost through the internet. Moreover, a letter is written by hand and carried by a postman, while an email is typed on a computer or mobile and sent electronically. A letter can be kept for years as a memory, but an email may be lost if the device is damaged. On the other hand, a handwritten letter carries a personal touch and emotion that an email often lacks. In spite of these differences, both a letter and an email serve the same purpose of exchanging news and views. In modern times, however, email has become far more popular.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Public University and a Private University'.
items.model: A public university and a private university are two types of higher educational institutions, and they differ in several ways. The most important difference is about cost. In a public university the cost of education is very low, so even poor students can study there, whereas in a private university the cost is very high and mainly the rich can afford it. In terms of admission, it is very hard to get a chance in a public university because of tough competition, while admission into a private university is comparatively easy. Public universities usually have large campuses, halls and playgrounds, whereas many private universities have small campuses. On the other hand, private universities often follow a fixed schedule and finish courses in time, while sessions in public universities are sometimes delayed. In spite of these differences, both types of university spread higher education and produce skilled people for the nation. So, both are important in their own way.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Nuclear Family and a Joint Family'.
items.model: A nuclear family and a joint family are two kinds of family, and they differ in many ways. A nuclear family is a small family that consists of parents and their children, while a joint family is a large family in which parents, children, grandparents and other relatives live together. In a nuclear family the number of members is small, so it is easy to maintain, whereas a joint family has many members and needs a large income. In a joint family children grow up under the care and affection of many people, while in a nuclear family they often feel lonely. On the other hand, there is more freedom and privacy in a nuclear family, but sometimes quarrels arise in a joint family over small matters. In spite of these differences, both types of family aim at love, security and happiness. In our country the joint family is slowly breaking up and the nuclear family is becoming more common.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Summer and the Rainy Season'.
items.model: Summer and the rainy season are two important seasons of Bangladesh, and they are quite different from each other. Summer is a hot and dry season, while the rainy season is wet and cool. In summer the sun shines brightly and the heat becomes unbearable, whereas in the rainy season the sky remains cloudy and it rains almost every day. The two seasons are different in their gifts too. Summer gives us sweet fruits like mango, jackfruit and litchi, while the rainy season fills the rivers and fields with water and helps in cultivation. In summer the rivers and canals dry up, whereas in the rainy season they overflow their banks. On the other hand, summer often causes suffering through heat and drought, and the rainy season sometimes brings floods. In spite of these differences, both seasons are useful to nature and to our farmers. Each season has its own beauty and importance in our life.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Physical Labour and Mental Labour'.
items.model: Physical labour and mental labour are two kinds of work, and both are important in life. Physical labour means the work done mainly with the body, while mental labour means the work done mainly with the mind. A farmer, a labourer and a blacksmith do physical labour, whereas a teacher, a doctor and a writer do mental labour. There is a difference in their nature too. Physical labour makes the body strong and healthy, while mental labour sharpens the brain and increases knowledge. In our society, mental labour is generally paid more and honoured more than physical labour, though this is not always fair. On the other hand, a person who does only physical work may remain poor, while a person who does mental work may earn a good living. However, both kinds of labour are necessary for society. A nation cannot progress without the combination of physical and mental labour, so both should be respected.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Cricket and Football'.
items.model: Cricket and football are two popular games of the world, but they differ in many ways. Football is played with a single ball and the feet, while cricket is played with a bat and a ball. A football team has eleven players and so has a cricket team, but the way of playing is quite different. A football match lasts only about ninety minutes, whereas a cricket match may last for hours or even days. In terms of cost, football is a cheap game and can be played by the poor, while cricket is a costly game that needs bats, pads and other equipment. Football is more exciting and full of continuous action, whereas cricket demands more patience and skill. On the other hand, both games are good for health and teach us discipline and team spirit. In our country both cricket and football are loved by the people, though cricket has become more popular in recent years.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Health and Wealth'.
items.model: Health and wealth are two things that people want most in life, but they are not the same. Health means the sound condition of the body and mind, while wealth means money and property. There is a close relation between the two, yet they are quite different. A healthy man can enjoy his life and work hard, whereas a wealthy man may have money but may not enjoy it if he is ill. Wealth can be earned again if it is lost, but health once lost is very hard to regain. Moreover, a healthy poor man is often happier than a wealthy sick man. On the other hand, wealth is also necessary, for without money one cannot buy food, clothes and medicine. Both health and wealth are needed for a happy life. However, health is more valuable than wealth, because a sound mind lives in a sound body. So, we should take care of our health first of all.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Teacher and a Doctor'.
items.model: A teacher and a doctor are two respected persons in our society, and both serve mankind in their own way. A teacher builds the mind of a nation, while a doctor takes care of its body. A teacher gives us knowledge and teaches us how to live, whereas a doctor treats us when we are ill and saves our lives. There is a difference in their working place too. A teacher works in a school, college or university, while a doctor works in a hospital, clinic or chamber. Both need long study and training to be skilled in their profession. On the other hand, a good teacher shapes the character of students, while a good doctor brings comfort to the suffering people. In truth, both a teacher and a doctor are like the two eyes of a nation. A nation needs both of them for its progress, so both deserve our respect and gratitude.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Facebook Friendship and Real Friendship'.
items.model: Facebook friendship and real friendship are two kinds of friendship in the modern age, and they differ greatly. Real friendship grows through direct meeting and long acquaintance, while Facebook friendship is made online, often between people who have never met. In real friendship two friends share their joys and sorrows face to face, whereas in Facebook friendship people mostly exchange messages, photos and likes. A real friend stands by us in danger and helps us in need, but a Facebook friend may disappear at the time of trouble. Moreover, real friendship is deep and lasting, while Facebook friendship is often shallow and temporary. On the other hand, Facebook has one good side; it helps us connect with people of distant places and keep in touch with old friends. In spite of this, real friendship is far more valuable than Facebook friendship. So, we should not depend only on online friends but should value our true friends.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'The Cinema and the Theatre'.
items.model: The cinema and the theatre are two means of entertainment, and both show us stories through acting, yet they differ in many ways. In the theatre actors perform live before the audience, while in the cinema the acting is recorded first and then shown on a screen. In the theatre a play is acted at a fixed time and place, whereas a film can be shown again and again anywhere. There is a difference in cost and technique too. A film uses cameras, lights and modern technology and can show grand scenes, while a stage play depends mostly on the skill of the actors. On the other hand, the theatre gives a living touch, because the audience and the actors are present together, but the cinema lacks this direct feeling. In modern times the cinema has become more popular than the theatre because of its convenience. However, the theatre still keeps its own charm as an old and living art.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Print Media and Electronic Media'.
items.model: Print media and electronic media are two main forms of mass media, and they differ in several ways. Print media includes newspapers, magazines and books, while electronic media includes television, radio and the internet. Print media presents news in written form on paper, whereas electronic media presents news through sound and moving pictures. In terms of speed, electronic media is much faster; it can give us breaking news within seconds, while print media takes time to be printed and delivered. On the other hand, print media can be kept and read again at any time, but electronic news passes quickly and cannot always be stored. Print media needs the reader to know how to read, whereas electronic media can reach even the illiterate people. In spite of these differences, both forms of media inform, educate and entertain us. In the modern age, however, electronic media is becoming more powerful and popular day by day.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Reading Books and Watching Television'.
items.model: Reading books and watching television are two ways of gaining knowledge and entertainment, but they differ in many ways. Reading a book needs attention and imagination, while watching television is easy and needs little effort. When we read a book, we build the pictures in our own mind, whereas television shows us ready-made pictures and sounds. Reading improves our language, thinking and imagination, while watching television mainly gives us information and amusement. There is a difference in time and control too. We can read a book at our own pace and pause whenever we wish, but a television programme runs at a fixed time and speed. On the other hand, television can show live events and distant places that a book cannot. In spite of these differences, both books and television are useful if we use them properly. However, reading books is more beneficial for the mind, so we should not give up the habit of reading.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Knowledge and Wealth'.
items.model: Knowledge and wealth are two things that people desire, but they are quite different from each other. Knowledge means learning and wisdom, while wealth means money and property. The greatest difference is that wealth decreases when it is spent, whereas knowledge increases the more it is shared. Wealth can be stolen or lost, but knowledge once gained remains with a person for ever. A wealthy man is honoured for his money, while a knowledgeable man is honoured for his wisdom everywhere. Moreover, wealth gives us comfort and pleasure of the body, whereas knowledge gives us light and pleasure of the mind. On the other hand, wealth is also necessary for our daily needs, and without some money even a learned man may suffer. However, knowledge is greater than wealth, because knowledge can earn wealth, but wealth cannot buy true knowledge. So, we should try to acquire knowledge first of all.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'A Pen and a Computer'.
items.model: A pen and a computer are two tools of writing, but they are very different from each other. A pen is a small and simple instrument that writes with ink on paper, while a computer is a modern electronic machine that can do many things besides writing. With a pen we can write slowly, one letter at a time, whereas with a computer we can type fast and correct mistakes easily. A pen is cheap and can be carried anywhere, while a computer is costly and needs electricity to run. On the other hand, a computer can store thousands of pages, do sums, show pictures and connect to the internet, which a pen cannot do. However, a pen never needs power and never breaks down like a machine, so it is useful everywhere at any time. In spite of the wonders of the computer, the pen still has its own importance. In fact, both a pen and a computer are useful in modern life.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'City Life and Village Life' from the viewpoint of a student.
items.model: City life and village life are quite different, especially from the viewpoint of a student. A student in the city gets many facilities that a village student does not. City schools and colleges are well equipped with good teachers, libraries and laboratories, whereas many village schools lack these facilities. A city student can easily get coaching, books and the internet, while a village student often struggles to get them. However, village life has some good sides for a student too. A village student studies in a calm and quiet environment full of fresh air, whereas a city student studies amid noise, crowd and pollution. Moreover, life in the city is costly and busy, while life in the village is cheap and simple. On the other hand, a city student gets more chances to develop his talent, but a village student learns to work hard against difficulties. In truth, both places have their own merits, and a sincere student can do well anywhere.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Honesty and Cleverness'.
items.model: Honesty and cleverness are two qualities found in human character, but they are quite different. Honesty means truthfulness and fairness in thought and action, while cleverness means sharpness of mind and skill in managing things. An honest man always speaks the truth and does no wrong, whereas a clever man may bend the truth to gain his end. Honesty wins the trust and respect of all people, while cleverness may bring quick success but often loses trust. There is a difference in their result too. Honesty gives lasting peace of mind, whereas cleverness may give profit for a short time but brings guilt in the long run. On the other hand, cleverness is not always bad; when it is joined with honesty, it becomes wisdom and does great good. However, honesty is greater than mere cleverness, because honesty is the best policy. So, we should be honest first and then wisely clever.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph comparing and contrasting 'Public Transport and a Private Car'.
items.model: Public transport and a private car are two means of travelling in a city, and each has its own good and bad sides. Public transport, such as buses and trains, carries many passengers together at a cheap fare, while a private car carries only a few people at a high cost. Travelling by public transport is cheap, so it suits the common people, whereas a private car is costly and mainly used by the rich. In terms of comfort, a private car is more comfortable and gives more freedom, while public transport is often crowded and uncomfortable. On the other hand, if everyone uses private cars, the roads become jammed and the air gets polluted, whereas public transport carries many people at once and reduces traffic jam and pollution. In spite of the comfort of a private car, public transport is better for the country as a whole. So, we should use public transport more to keep our cities clean and free from jam.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে
